sourceText: Step 3 of the evidence-integrity program (docs/evidence-integrity-program-spec.md §3, docs/step3-review-budget-breaker-handoff.md): the review-budget circuit breaker. Turn the currently advisory-only review-convergence stall detector into a mandatory blocking adjudication so a story cannot mint unlimited ordinary review rounds without a recorded escalation, re-plan, finding resolution, or unreachable-item declaration. Fixes class ② (runaway review rounds; F-058 took 12 rounds to surface an unreachable item, F-059 plan.md drifted).
normalizedOutcome: When REVIEW has stalled (>= STALL_MIN_ROUNDS non-improving), re-entering REVIEW to mint another ordinary round is refused with a structured prompt; the block clears only by a recorded structured action (incl. declare-checklist-item-unreachable, which closes the loop); a hard ceiling/override prevents indefinite ignoring; and the advance-counting convergence-breaker + story_resume --ack still work without double-counting.
acceptanceClaim: A stalled story's next ordinary review round is refused until a signed current-round structured resolution is recorded; declaring a checklist item unreachable closes the loop instead of spinning; and the existing convergence-breaker is not double-counted — all proven by one registered RED-first smoke reproducing the stall refusal and the F-058 unreachable scenario.
